procedure.name: replace-hardcoded-names
procedure.step: Search for hardcoded namespace, class, function, or method name strings
Replace with dynamic reflection: __CLASS__ . '::' . __FUNCTION__ f'{cls.__name__}::{inspect.currentframe().f_code.co_name}' this.constructor.name (or function.name for declarations)
Store class name acronym in a constant for brevity when repeated

procedure.name: replace-repetitive-assignments
procedure.step: Identify 3+ consecutive assignments to the same target (attributes, properties, style values)
Collect key-value pairs into an iterable structure (array of tuples, Object.entries, dict)

procedure.name: convert-if-else-to-ternary
procedure.precondition: Both branches produce exactly one statement (assignment or return)
procedure.step: Verify branches are single-statement and symmetric
For JS: avoid ternary ending in nullish when it's a standalone expression (triggers no-unused-expressions)

procedure.name: suggest-snippets
procedure.trigger: The same code generation pattern appears 3+ times in a session
procedure.step: Identify the repeated pattern and its variable placeholders
Generate a VS Code snippet definition (JSON) with $1/$2 tab-stops
Present to user for confirmation before saving
